label: Structured shared-IO feature process - production59 - stateless numbered layers - K1 2x1s input x 59 - K2 2x1s embedding density - 16 causal base-support paths x 17 primitive coordinates rederived to 59 and encoded by shared layer 1 as Gaussian keys - scalar softmax component masses - exact expected base features - layer 8 causal self-attention Q/K/V/O256 center - fixed sigma 4 normalized mixture NLL - W256 M128 P128 F128 PF256 NF256 - 256k clean - batch 10240 train/evaluation - no regularization - EMA 4

layer8Attention.causality: output step s attends only to generated NF states <=s

featureEmbeddingDensity.baseValueSource: current NF state emits 16 standardized 17-coordinate offsets around the layer-8/layer-2 base center
featureEmbeddingDensity.keySource: each base support path is causally rederived to the complete production59 path and encoded by the exact shared layer 1
featureEmbeddingDensity.massSource: current NF state emits 16 scalar logits normalized by softmax
featureEmbeddingDensity.expectation: sum of component mass times raw 17-coordinate base support

architecture.numberedLayerSharing: each parenthesized numbered layer is one exact shared stateless GNGLU reused at every matching block; no layer carries private recurrent memory
architecture.densityState: shared layer 7 maps PF to NF; causal layer 8 and shared layer 2 give the base center; NF produces component base offsets and masses; causal rollout plus shared layer 1 turns component base paths into embedding-space Gaussian keys
architecture.pointDecoder: layer 2 supplies only the common base-support center; reported point predictions are exact mixture expectations of the component base values

loss.description: mean exact normalized Gaussian-mixture negative log likelihood of both realized future production59 states after shared-layer-1 encoding; all keys originate from causal base-feature support, and no MSE auxiliary loss is optimized

sampling.description: the exact production59 dense chronological nonzero-target population with two observed rows and two realized future rows per origin
sampling.comparisonControl: same K1/K2, latent widths, data population, optimizer, examples, and EMA as the preceding free-key embedding-density run

evaluation.headline: realized layer-1 feature-embedding negative log likelihood
evaluation.checkpointSelection: lowest full-validation two-step embedding NLL, with additional durable best expected-feature MSE and correlation checkpoints
evaluation.pointMetrics: mixture-weighted expected 17-coordinate base state and mixture-weighted expected causally derived 59-feature state

alignment.input: two consecutive production59 rows ending at each control origin
alignment.target: the complete chronological production59 rows at origin+1 and origin+2, encoded by the exact shared layer 1
alignment.causality: every component is a two-step primitive path rederived from only the observed prefix and that component's earlier primitive value; target embeddings are used only as stop-gradient likelihood queries
alignment.supportMeaning: each Gaussian mean has an attached raw 17-coordinate base value, so expected base features use the same probability masses as NLL
alignment.normalization: component masses use softmax and every embedding key is a fixed-scale normalized Gaussian component with its exact finite normalizer
